subject: lavaan WARNING: data argument looks like a covariance matrix; please use the sample.cov argument ins

messages.author: 9da3c71a89709b4f
messages.subject: lavaan WARNING: data argument looks like a covariance matrix; please use the sample.cov argument ins
parts:
Hello all,
do you have any idea what I can do to fit my model without getting this error message?
Thx a lot!


> fit.correct.model1 <- cfa(correct.model1, std.lv=TRUE, data = my.data1)

Fehler in lavData(data = data, group = group, group.label = group.label,  : 
  lavaan WARNING: data argument looks like a covariance matrix; please use the sample.cov argument instead

> summary(fit.correct.model1, fit.measures=TRUE)

Fehler in summary(fit.correct.model1, fit.measures = TRUE) : 
  Fehler bei der Auswertung des Argumentes 'object' bei der Methodenauswahl
für Funktion 'summary': Fehler: Objekt 'fit.correct.model1' nicht gefunden

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: lavaan WARNING: data argument looks like a covariance matrix; please use the sample.cov argument ins
parts:
No.  Your syntax implies that you are using individual level observations, not a covariance matrix.  If you are using a covariance matrix, then, instead of data=, you should be using sample.cov=, just like the error message says.  This error message is being very specific and direct in pointing to the mistake.
--Ed Rigdon
